d: Our client, an events-focused organisation in Dubai, is looking for an Administrative & Logistics Coordinator to join their team on a full-time or part-time basis, starting as soon as possible.

This is not a traditional secretarial role. You will keep the team’s day-to-day running smoothly, covering everything from diaries and meetings to international shipments, event travel and supplier orders. You will:
Keep calendars, meetings and office systems organised
Get shipments and deliveries to where they need to be, on time
Make sure team members travelling to events have their flights, hotels and plans in place
Manage supplier quotes, orders and follow-ups

You will often be juggling several tasks at once and will be trusted to manage your own workload with minimal supervision. The role suits someone highly organised, proactive and confident taking ownership of a wide range of admin and logistics tasks.
q: Strong attention to detail and a high level of organisation.
Proven ability to manage several tasks independently and to deadlines.
A proactive, confident approach to problem-solving.
Proficiency with standard office software (email, calendars, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace). Ideal Background
Previous experience in an administrative, logistics or coordination role
Experience arranging international shipments and event travel is a strong advantage
Experience in the events industry is a strong advantage
Full-time or part-time: Both options are available.
Start date: As soon as possible.
Based in Dubai: The role is based in Dubai.
r: Manage calendars and diaries for the team.
Handle day-to-day office administration, keeping systems, records and supplies in order.
Liaise with couriers and logistics providers.
Track items through to delivery and resolve any issues along the way.
Book flights, hotels and travel for team members attending events.
Keep all travel plans organised and up to date.
Request quotes from suppliers and place orders.
Follow up on deliveries to make sure everything arrives as agreed.
Prioritise and manage several tasks at once to deadlines.

d: We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.
We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals.

Our team is small and talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin and Windsurf is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.
At Cognition, customers are our highest priority. Deployed Engineers (DEs) are customer-facing technical experts who help our customers maximize the value they get out of Devin/Windsurf.

You’ll work directly with engineers to understand their workflows, identify high-impact use cases, and deploy Devin/Windsurf into real production environments. You’ll lead demos and pilots, support integrations, and drive adoption of the Cognition platform from the inside out.

This role combines hands-on technical work, customer partnership, and rapid execution. You'll serve a broad range of clients, switching context frequently and staying ahead of issues before they become blockers. You're expected to be proactive, make judgment calls, and take ownership of outcomes.
q: Strong engineering foundation from a rigorous technical environment
Demonstrated track record of exceptional performance in whatever you've pursued, whether academic, athletic, professional, or entrepreneurial
Self-directed by default. You don't need a manager to tell you what to do next or how to prioritize.
Strong communication skills. You can hold your own with senior engineers and executives alike.
Have a high tolerance for ambiguity, intensity, and sustained effort when the problem demands it.
Advanced in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript)
Experience writing and debugging real software systems
Want to work directly with real users on high-impact technical problems
Learn quickly by being embedded in challenging, real-world environments
Have worked at an early-stage startup or in a role where you operated well beyond your job description

r: Own all technical aspects of the customer lifecycle—from deployment through activation, making sure our customers are successful using Devin

Build deep relationships with our customers’ engineering teams to ensure smooth product integration and adoption, activating top users and driving product utilization
Build! Always listen to customer feedback, have a bias towards implementing requested features yourself, and advocate for the customers’ needs with the rest of the team

d: This is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the successful delivery of transmission, distribution, substation and utility infrastructure projects, ensuring operational excellence, commercial performance and sustainable business growth.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in electrical EPC and utility projects, established industry relationships, strong commercial acumen and a proven ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams.
q: Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in electrical EPC, transmission and distribution (T&D), substation or utility infrastructure projects.
At least 10 years in project management and leadership roles .
Demonstrated experience delivering major power and electrical infrastructure projects in Oman or the GCC.
Proven hands-on experience with OETC, Nama/NEDC, DCRP and PDO projects, requirements and approvals.
Strong understanding of project prequalification, technical compliance, regulatory requirements and HSE standards.
Demonstrated experience in commercial and contract management, including P&L ownership.
Proven track record in business development, securing new projects and managing key client relationships.
Excellent leadership, negotiation, stakeholder management and decision-making skills.
Relevant individual competencies and professional authorisations.
Desirable: PMP certification or an equivalent project management qualification.
r: Provide strategic and operational leadership across the company's power and electrical infrastructure projects.
Oversee the complete project lifecycle, from tendering and mobilisation through execution, commissioning and final handover.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations, approved budgets, quality standards and agreed timelines.
Drive project financial performance, including budgeting, cost control, profitability and P&L accountability.
Lead, mentor and develop project managers, engineers and multidisciplinary project teams.
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with key clients, consultants, authorities and industry stakeholders, including OETC, Nama and PDO.
Oversee contractual matters, commercial negotiations, risk management and project claims.
Ensure compliance with applicable HSE requirements, technical standards and regulatory approvals.

d: We are seeking a proficient Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimising mechanical systems and components for various construction projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project specifications.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical design engineering, preferably in the construction industry.
Proficiency in CAD and BIM software such as AutoCAD, Revit, and SolidWorks.
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems including HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection.
Familiarity with local building codes and regulations.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple tasks effectively.
r: Develop detailed mechanical designs, drawings, and specifications for HVAC, plumbing, and other mechanical systems.
Use CAD and BIM software (AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks) to prepare layouts and 3D models.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate mechanical designs with architectural and structural layouts.
Conduct engineering calculations and simulations to verify design viability and performance.
Review and revise designs based on project requirements, codes, and client feedback.
Ensure all designs comply with local regulations and industry standards.
Coordinate with contractors, and suppliers to support project execution.
Participate in site visits to monitor installation and resolve design-related issues.
